As at M01, the property limb itself mixes land with shares in another 模合.

notes: 八、落札人ハ即日連中ノ承諾アル連帶證人三名ヲ付シ各人ニ證書ヲ差出スコト; a winning bid without sureties passes to the second bid (十一). No property named.
No division of an unmet loss. 十二 divides an unspent litigation reserve equally (講員全部ニ平分スル), a distribution of a reserve, not of a loss.

source_ref: S p. 79, items 八, 十四
notes: Debtor route: nothing binds the drawer beyond his sureties. Association route: the sureties need 連中ノ承諾 (八), which, as at M03, reads as approval by the members rather than a requirement that they be members; unlike A03, no other item shows the sureties are members. .NR, not 0.

source_ref: S p. 79, items 五, 八
notes: Compelled in words: 五、積立時間迄ニ積立セザルモノハ過怠金トシテ金參拾錢ヲ徴收スルコト, and three joint sureties on drawing (八). UNWON MEMBERS (rule 5): item 五 applies to every member alike; nothing further for an undrawn member who stops.

source_ref: S p. 79, items 八, 十二-十四, closing formula
notes: The members decide: the rules were 連中協議ノ上決定; the reserve is held by 連中選定セル委員 (十二), whose reward is fixed 連中協議ノ上 (十三); sureties need the members' consent (八). A 企主 exists but is given no power and is expressly kept from standing surety for all (十四). Medium: no meeting procedure is stated.

A rice fund (第一條 掛米ハ一人ニ付四斗米五俵トス), paid in credit-cooperative warehouse receipts; drawn members pay five bales a round, undrawn three (第六條). Read arts. 1-14, the closing formula and signature heads (昭和五年舊九月十三日). For a drawn member the rules go to his sureties and stop: 第七條 落札人ニ於テ同時刻迄ニ入庫票提出セサル時ハ保證人ニ於テ即時預リ證ヲ提供シ入札ニ不都合ナサシメサルモノトス (S p. 80), with 第八條 落札人ハ本人及連中承諾ノ連帶保證人二人以上トス and a joint bond to the undrawn members (第十四條). Nothing names a bearer if the sureties fail. Art. 14 refers to a 連帶證書 'below' (左ノ); no form is printed with the rules, and none of 其ノ八-十 was used because none names this association (see notes).

Two or more joint sureties approved by the members (第八條), who must deliver a deposit receipt if the drawer does not (第七條), and a joint bond to the undrawn members (第十四條); without sureties the pot is re-auctioned (第九條). The warehouse receipts are the medium of contribution, not security.
Read throughout; no division of an unmet loss.

Debtor route: the drawer owes interest in rice on late delivery (第六條 損害トシテ一俵ニ付一日貳升也ノ割合ニテ利子ヲ附スル) - his own obligation. Association route: 連中承諾ノ連帶保證人 (第八條) requires the members' consent, not that the sureties be members; no clause shows they are. .NR, not 0.

Compelled in words: interest in rice on late delivery (第六條), sureties must deliver at once (第七條), and whoever causes a meeting to fail bears that day's costs (若シ定日ニ落札人又ハ保證人共出會セサル爲メ結合不可能ノ場合ハ當日損害（賄料）ヲ全部其ノ人ノ負擔トス). UNWON MEMBERS (rule 5): the interest of 第六條 applies to undrawn members' three bales as to drawn members' five; nothing further.

The only allocated decisions sit with the members: sureties need 連中承諾 (第八條, 第九條), and the keeper of the rulebook, if he draws, is replaced 未落札人中ヨリ (第十三條). A 會主 hosts and gives notice (arts. 2, 4) without any stated power. Low: one kind of decision, no meeting clause - the same evidence as M03, with a convener added.

source_ref: S p. 81, the 一-item on the 講長 and 世話人
notes: Read all 一-items to 以上 (no date or signatures printed). Drawn shares (黒株) repay by monthly instalments for the full hundred months, so a payout creates a debt to the fund. The rules put the gap on the officers: 一、講長及世話人ハ懸金ノ遲怠者ノ有無ニ不拘糶取金支拂ヲ保證スル爲自分所有ノ白株壹株ハ最終迄糶取ラサルコト、糶取金ハ擔保物件提供同時ニ全額支拂ヒヲ爲スコト (S p. 81): the head and stewards guarantee that each pot is paid in full whether or not members fall behind, and keep one undrawn share of their own to the end as backing. That is liability for default itself (rule 3 does not apply - nothing about mishandling), and it is the last bearer named after the drawer's 擔保物件 (rule 2). MEDIUM, alternative stated fairly: 遲怠 is lateness, and the clause guarantees that pots are paid on time; whether the officers bear a drawn member's final non-payment, or only advance it, is not said, and their backing may be read as capped at the held-back share. If the guarantee is liquidity only, the cell is .NR.

NO FITTING VALUE: the drawer must give security - 糶取金ハ擔保物件提供同時ニ全額支拂ヒヲ爲スコト - but the kind of 擔保物件 is not named, so neither real-estate nor goods nor any other state can be written (as at ko_meio_1498, where the pledge's object is unnamed). No surety is required of the drawer.
No division of an unmet loss; the officers' guarantee names who, not how.

Association route: the head and stewards hold shares of their own (自分所有ノ白株) and guarantee payment of every pot 懸金ノ遲怠者ノ有無ニ不拘 - members answering for other members' obligations. The value holds even on the liquidity reading in the RD-test note: a guarantor who must pay for another is pursued beyond his own contribution.

The drawer must give 擔保物件 before he is paid: 1 under the 2026-10-22 ruling. Medium: no consequence of non-payment is stated in words; the rules mention 懸金ノ遲怠者 only to say the officers guarantee the pots regardless. UNWON MEMBERS (rule 5): nothing said.

Decision is fixed by office: 一、本講ハ龍川寺住職ヲ以テ講長トシ壇家總代人ノ職ニアル者ヲ以テ取締役世話人トス, and 一、其ノ他ノ必要事項ニ就テハ講長及取締役世話人ニ於テ協議ノ上之ヲ決ス (S p. 81). Members elect no one and decide nothing. The temple's incumbent and the parish representatives decide by standing position: the nearest existing value is 'elder-fixed'. LOW because the vocabulary does not define the value, and the 壇家總代 are representatives rather than elders by age; and the temple also takes the first instalment as a donation (初會懸金壹株金參圓也ヲ龍川寺維持金トシテ寄附スルコト), which is the temple-convener pattern recorded .NR at M04 and ko_hokoin_1832. The difference here is a clause that expressly vests residual decisions in the fixed officers. See answer 4.

Read arts. 1-13 (no date or signatures printed). SCOPE, argued: this is a savings fund that lends, not a rotating fund - 第一條 本講ハ德下村ため講ト稱シ一口ニ付玄米一俵ヲ貯蓄スルモノトス, and 第八條 積立米ハ役員會ニ於テ適當ノ價格ニ換算シ左ニ該當スルモノニ貸付利殖スルモノトス, to members approved by the board and, failing them, outsiders (一、講員ニシテ借入ノ申請ヲ爲シ理事會ノ承認ヲ得タルモノ 二、講員外ト雖モ理事會ノ承認ヲ得タルモノ). It is not a club that 'only accumulates and returns': a loan to a member is a payout that creates a debt owed to the fund, so the applicability condition is met and the cell is not .NA. On that reading the rules are silent: the only provision on repayment is security - 三、前二項ノ場合ハ講員ヲ先トシ各二名ノ保證人ヲ付スルモノトス (S pp. 81-82, art. 8) - and nothing names a bearer if borrower and sureties fail. Raised in answer 4: the definition's applicability clause reaches this fund, but its population sentence (contribute in rounds, receive a pot) fits it only loosely.
Two sureties for every loan: 前二項ノ場合ハ講員ヲ先トシ各二名ノ保證人ヲ付スルモノトス (art. 8). No property named. The secured advance is a loan from savings, which may go to non-members.
No division of a loss. Surplus is credited annually as dividends with the members' approval (第九條); losses are not mentioned.
Debtor route: nothing binds a borrower beyond his sureties. Association route: the sureties' membership is not stated; 講員ヲ先トシ gives members priority as borrowers, not as sureties. .NR, not 0.

A rule requiring a borrowing member to give two sureties for what he owes (第八條 三) is 1 under the 2026-10-22 ruling. Medium: no consequence of non-payment is stated, and the rules say nothing at all about a member who fails to deliver his rice contribution - the obligation the characteristic primarily concerns. UNWON MEMBERS (rule 5): not applicable in form (there are no rounds or draws); a leaver forfeits that year's dividend (第十條 二、退講者ハ其ノ年ノ配當ヲ受ケサルモノトス).

The members govern through a general meeting: 第三條 本講ニ左ノ役員ヲ置キ各任期ヲ一ケ年トシ毎年總會ニ於テ之ヲ選擧ス 理事四名 監事三名; an annual general meeting decides the accounts (第十一條), with a quorum of half the members (第十二條); continuation beyond five years is for 總會ノ決議 (第二條). The board decides each loan and deposit (第六條) and matters outside the rules need the 役員會's approval (第十三條), but the board is elected yearly and audited (第七條).

Read the preamble, 頼母子講組合定款 arts. 1-41 and the signature block (大正八年參月; names left as 何某, so this too is a model text). A drawer (義務者, 第九條) gives security approved by the officers and a loan deed (第八條) and repays 120 yen a period (第貳拾九條). The default clause ends at his security: 第參拾壹條 義務者ニ於テ第貳拾九條ノ返金ガ壹期以上延滯スルトキハ何等催告ノ手續ヲ要セズ直チニ抵當物件ヲ處分スルモノトス (S p. 148), with immediate repayment of the whole remaining debt if the pledge falls short and is not topped up (第參拾六條) - his own liability, rule 4. Nothing says who bears a shortfall after the pledge is sold. 第參拾九條 本講定款以外ノ要件ハ役員會ノ決議ヲ以テ處理スル事アルベシ is a general clause about unprovided matters and, under rule 7, is not 'deferred'. The small bills each member holds (小手形, arts. 10-11) record that the 抵當預リ人 holds the drawer's security; they do not make anyone liable for it.

第參拾四條 本講抵當物件ハ政府發行ノ諸債券並ニ役員會ニ於テ認諾スル有價證券及田畑宅地建物トス 但シ不動產所在地ハ德島市元標ヨリ三里以內ニ限ルモノトス (S p. 148): government bonds, approved securities, or land and buildings, held by the 抵當預リ人 as mortgagee for all members (第拾八條), with fire insurance on buildings (第參拾七條) and top-up on loss of value (第參拾六條). No surety. Coded mixed in the several-kinds-of-property sense recorded at ko_mitarai_gin_1805, not property-plus-surety; medium because no RB3 value holds securities, and a reader could take 'real-estate' as the primary limb.

Read throughout; no division of an unmet loss. Bank interest is shared equally among all members, drawn or not (第拾參條 但書), a distribution of a gain; 第貳拾八條 apportions each pot, less the drawers' repayments and feast costs, among the undrawn members as their contribution - an allocation of contributions, not of a loss.

Debtor route: acceleration of the drawer's remaining debt on a failed top-up (第參拾六條 ...其當時殘債務ヲ一時ニ返金請求スルモノトス) and damages at 3 % a month (第參拾條) concern his own debt; no clause binds his person or whole estate beyond the pledge. Association route: no member answers for another. .NR, not 0 - nothing confines liability to the pledge.

Compelled in words: 第參拾條 前條ノ掛金ヲ怠リタル場合ハ其理由如何ヲ不論月三分ノ割合ヲ以テ損害金ヲ附加シ請求スルモノトス, and sale of the pledge without notice after one period's arrears (第參拾壹條). UNWON MEMBERS (rule 5): members must pay monthly, drawn or not (第拾貳條); a member who wants to leave needs the general meeting's consent and gets back his principal only at the end (第參拾八條). No sanction for an unwon member's non-payment is stated.

Officers are elected from the members at the general meeting for three years (第拾四條, 第拾五條), vacancies are filled at the next meeting (第貳拾壹條), withdrawals are decided by the meeting (第參拾八條), and amendment needs 總會ニ於テ義務者ヲ除クノ外權利組合員三分ノ二以上ノ同意 (第四拾條) - a vote confined to undrawn members. Medium because day-to-day business and collection rest with the founding beneficiary: 第五條 本講取扱人ハ講期間滿了スル迄本講ニ屬スル諸般ノ事務及集金取扱ハ凡テ無手數ヲ以テ發起取前人何某ニ於テ之ヲ取扱フモノトス, the house practice's insider-organiser, here under a member-elected board.

Read the preamble (明治四十一年六月, 取扱人 何某), 第參號積立同盟講規約 arts. 1-30 and the officers' list (another model text with 何某 throughout). The drawer (債務者) repays nine yen a month (第五條) against land, buildings or securities (第八條), registered before payout (第九條), topped up on the inspectors' demand (第拾六條); the 抵當預リ人 holds and enforces the mortgage for all members (第貳拾參條 抵當預リ人ハ講員ヲ代表シテ抵當權利者トナリ...抵當權及債權並ニ擔保物處分等總テ權利實行ニ關スル權限ヲ有ス, S p. 150). No clause says what happens if the pledge does not cover the debt. DECISION POINT, stated fairly: the drawer's debt is split into small bills, one to each undrawn member - 第貳拾條 取前人ハ各權利者ヘ對シ人別ニ小手形ヲ渡スコトヲ要ス - and is discharged once all are paid (第貳拾貳條). Structurally, then, an unrecovered shortfall would lie with whichever members hold his bills, which a reader might code 'all-members' (or LS1 pro-rata). Not coded: that allocation follows from the form of the debt, not from any clause about default, and rule 6 forbids supplying it. Raised in answer 4 (the value set assumes the debt is owed to a fund). T01 has the same bill structure (its 第拾條).

第八條 債務者ト確定シタルモノハ其返金額ニ相當スル土地建物並ニ有價證券等ヲ以テ抵當及擔保トシ (S p. 149), land and buildings registered before payout (第九條), within five ri of 德島市 (第貳拾五條), buildings insured at the debtor's cost (第貳拾六條). No surety. 'mixed' in the several-kinds-of-property sense, as at T01; medium because no RB3 value holds securities.

No division of an unmet loss is stated. The surplus between collection and the winning bid is carried to the next period (第拾條); penalties go to the fund (第拾八條). The pro-rata reading suggested by the small-bill structure (see RD-test) is not a clause and is not coded.

Debtor route: the drawer's obligation is his repayment, secured by his pledge, and ends when his small bills are paid (第貳拾貳條); nothing binds his person or whole estate beyond the pledge. Association route: no member answers for another. .NR, not 0.

Compelled in words: 第七條 ...若シ期限ヲ經過スルモ出金遲滯スル時ハ一日金圓ニ付金壹錢宛ノ過怠金ヲ差出サシムルモノトス猶日數ハ廿日限リトシ二十一日ニ涉ル時ハ掛切レリト看做スモノトス (S p. 149), with a pledge required of every drawer (第八條). UNWON MEMBERS (rule 5): 第拾壹條 毎月ノ掛金ヲ怠リ掛ケ切レトナル人ハ其掛込ミアル金ハ滿講ノ上無利息ヲ以テ返金スルモノトス - a member who lapses gets his payments back without interest at the end.

Officers are elected from the undrawn members (第拾五條 講員中ノ有權者中ヨリ抵當預リ人壹名檢査役參名ヲ選擧シ), the paid organiser (取扱人, fee under 第六條) must consult them and can be dismissed and replaced by the creditor members - 第拾七條 取扱人ハ鄭重ヲ旨トシ萬事役員ト協議シ一モ專斷ノ處置ナク...萬一不至當ノ取扱アルトキハ債權者ノ決議ヲ以テ之ヲ罷免スルコトヲ得ベシ (S p. 150) - and amendments are decided 集會ノ上 (第參拾條). Medium: the decisive body is the undrawn members rather than all members, and an organiser runs day-to-day business.

Read arts. 1-32, the small-bill form printed inside art. 9, and the election record and signatures (大正九年參月; names as 何某 except the temple's incumbent, not repeated). The drawer (債務者, 第六條) gives a first mortgage on land and buildings or securities (第拾八條) and hands each paying member a small bill (第九條). Default runs to the drawer's own bond and stops: 第貳拾壹條 ...若シ其ノ月中ニ仕拂ヲ爲サザル時ハ左ノ處分ヲ爲ス ... 二、債務者ニ於テハ債務證書ニ依リ處分ス (S p. 153), and the bill he signs reads 萬一返金ヲ相怠リ限日ヲ經過ナシタル時ハ本講抵當預リ人ト締結セシ證書ヲ以テ直チニ執行セラレ抵當物件糶賣及拙者所有ノ財產ヲ以テ速ニ返辨可致候 (S p. 152, art. 9) - the pledge, then his own property. Both are the defaulter's own liability (rule 4). Nothing names a bearer if they fall short. 糶 was read with difficulty at viewer resolution; the same compound is clear in the separately printed form (四) on p. 158, used only as a reading aid. As at T02, the debt is owed to the holders of the small bills, not to a fund (see answer 4).

第拾八條 本講ニ於テ採用スル擔保物件ハ左ノ貳種ニ限ル 一、德島元標ヨリ參里以內ニ存在スル土地建物 二、有價證券 但土地建物ハ一番抵當ニ限ル (S p. 153), valued by the officers (第拾七條), insured (第拾八條), topped up on any fall in value (第貳拾條). 'mixed' in the several-kinds-of-property sense, as at T01 and T02. ALTERNATIVE: the small bill adds 拙者所有ノ財產 behind the pledge (art. 9), which a reader could take for 'general-estate' alongside the mortgage; not adopted, because it is an undertaking to pay out of his property, not a charge on it. Medium.

No division of an unmet loss. Bank interest is shared with drawn members as well (第拾條 尤モ銀行預金利子ニ限リ債務者ヘモ割リ當ルモノトス); auction differences and penalties offset the next contributions - distributions of gains.

Debtor route under the 2026-10-22 ruling: the drawer is expressly liable beyond his pledge with his own property - 本講抵當預リ人ト締結セシ證書ヲ以テ直チニ執行セラレ抵當物件糶賣及拙者所有ノ財產ヲ以テ速ニ返辨可致候 (art. 9). Not the association route: no member answers for another. Medium: 拙者所有ノ財產 is his property generally, which reads as the whole estate the ruling names (sea_loan, bodemerij_amsterdam), but it is not said in terms; and the form is the bill as printed in the rules, with the bond the 抵當預リ人 drafts (第貳拾貳條) not printed.

Compelled in words: 第貳拾壹條 連衆若シ掛金拂込遲延ノ場合ハ壹百圓ニ付壹日金四錢ノ割ヲ以テ日歩ヲ支出スルモノトス, then expulsion or enforcement of the bond; loss of the instalment term if the pledge is not topped up (第貳拾條 若シ之レニ應ゼザルトキハ納崩シ期限ノ利益ヲ失フモノトス). UNWON MEMBERS (rule 5): 一、債權者ニ於テハ當然連衆ヲ脫除シタルモノトシ當時現掛込金ハ滿講ノ末元金ヲ返戻ヘルモノトス (第貳拾壹條) - removed, principal returned without interest at the end.

Members elect the officers (第貳拾六條 本講連衆ノ互選ヲ以テ左ノ役員ヲ置キ), decide meetings by majority (第拾貳條 集會ノ議事ハ出席連衆多數ノ意見ヲ以テ決ス), amend by majority (第參拾貳條), and may dismiss the agent (第參拾條 連衆ニ於テ代理取扱人ヲ不信任ト決議シタル時ハ之ヲ解任スベシ). Medium: the temple's incumbent is the first drawer and appoints the agent who runs business (第參拾條), and the first pot is donated to the temple (第二條) - the temple-convener pattern of M04 and A06 - but here under an elected board answerable to a majority.
